newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends higher on exports, funds, soybeans.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends higher on exports, funds, soybeans.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed higher on bullish export news, fund buying and on a surge in CBOT soybeans, traders said.
"There was commission house and fund buying all day and commercial selling or hedge selling above the market," a trader said.
USDA Thursday said U.S. net export sales of wheat during the week ended July 24 totalled 964,300 tonnes, above expectations for 700,000 to 800,000 tonnes.
KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed four to 7-1/4 cents per bushel higher, with September up 6-3/4 at $3.71-1/4.
KCBT futures volume was estimated by the KCBT at 47,020 contracts, above the 31,430 traded Wednesday.
